archetypes.name: dyn-stall-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Optional evidence handling must not regress ledger recording semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed stall recovery ledger path. Focus on record_escalation behavior for invalid, oversize, and truncate-failed detail logs. Verify hard_fail remains limited to true recording failures and token or path validation failures. Check that fallback ledger semantics still return success when fallback evidence is written. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-evidence-paths
archetypes.rationale: The sidecar and lint-fix paths handle filesystem trust boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the failure-detail-log classifier, sidecar materialization, and lint-fix ledger path canonicalization. Focus on tmpdir containment, symlink races, no-follow behavior where available, and whether unsafe paths can be opened or attached. Check that oversize sidecars are re-verified before appearing in the ledger. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
